name: Ankyloblepharon Filiforme Adnatum-Cleft Palate Syndrome
aliases: Ankyloblepharon Filiforme Adnatum with Cleft Palate

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Ankyloblepharon Filiforme Adnatum-Cleft Palate Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of ankyloblepharon filiforme adnatum characterized by fine bands of tissue partially or completely fusing the upper and lower eyelids
Congenital cleft palate detected clinically or radiologically
Presence of syndactyly or other limb malformations
Characteristic facial dysmorphic features including broad nasal bridge and micrognathia

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of ankyloblepharon filiforme adnatum and cleft palate
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not mandatory

searchTerms: tight bands around limbs in womb
constriction rings on baby limbs before birth

occasional.symptomName: Non-midline cleft of the upper lip
searchTerms: upper lip cleft not on midline

other: Physical examination revealing syndactyly and facial dysmorphism

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of ectodermal dysplasia features such as hair and nail abnormalities

redFlags: Airway obstruction due to cleft palate
Severe feeding difficulties leading to failure to thrive
references: Orphanet: Ankyloblepharon filiforme adnatum-cleft palate syndrome - ORPHA:1072
Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man (OMIM) Entry on TP63-related disorders
Smith et al., 2018. Clinical and genetic characterization of Ankyloblepharon filiforme adnatum-cleft palate syndrome. Journal of Medical Genetics.
